Sensor Tower estimates 10.2M US downloads through Oct. 17, with daily active users up 15% week over week.

Early retention looks encouraging too. 23% of September installers were still coming back after two weeks. But search interest has cooled, and Meta is spending heavily to promote the app.

The $10B charge alone is going to weigh heavily on reported earnings.

zh_summary: 所以$SPCX顯然用那些財報轟開了大門，尤其是如果Elon接近明年上線20GW的目標。現在的問題似乎是這對其他每個新雲端公司意味著什麼。SpaceX今天上漲，其他平盤到下跌。一方面，$SPCX證明瞭新雲端商業模式的重要性以及需求有多大。另一方面，$SPCX太好了，現在人們懷疑其他新雲端能否輕易融資運營，這些公司相比Elon能多快上線計算能力，以及SpaceX自己為了融資建設需要承擔多少債務/稀釋，這又引發了小玩家需要多少稀釋的問題。SpaceX也是盈利的，而其他公司距離盈利還有多年。我的看法更多是$SPCX驗證了整個新雲端概念，顯然過去兩週$CRWV債券受打擊下一直承壓，但財報也太好了，現在可能對其他人執行能力有更多疑問。更廣泛的主題似乎從那些財報中得到合法化：計算約束存在且沒有以任何有意義的方式緩解。
en_summary: so $SPCX obviously blew the doors out with those earnings especially if Elon gets anywhere close to his goal of bringing 20GW online by next year. The question now seems to be what this means for every other neocloud. SpaceX is up today, the rest are flat to red. On one hand, $SPCX proved how important the neocloud business model is and how much demand is out there. On the other hand, $SPCX was so good that now people are doubting the ability for other neoclouds to easily finance their operations, how quickly those companies can bring compute online compared to Elon, and how much debt/dilution SpaceX themselves will have to take on to finance that buildout which then begs the question around how much dilution the smaller players will have to take on. SpaceX is also profitable whereas the others are years from profitability. My take is more that $SPCX has validated the entire concept of neoclouds which obviously have been under stress given the $CRWV bonds getting hit over the past two weeks, but the earnings were also so good that there might be more questions now about how well the others can execute. The broader theme seemed to be legitimized from those earnings: the compute constraints exist and have not eased up in any meaningful way.

text: There is no question in my mind that there is circular financing going on today. But it occurred during the internet bubble as well. But this continued for 2-3 years before THE TOP was reached in March of 2000. I think the more marginal neo-cloud players will have issues getting future financing but the stronger companies will be able to keep this going into 2027. Some of the biggest spenders, like $AMZN, $GOOGL, $MSFT, have the best balance sheets and massive other businesses to fund their AI investment and backstop debt for some of the neoclouds. Not to mention $NVDA and $AVGO that have massive cash flows to invest and backstop debt as well due to the above public cloud vendors buying their chips.
